note: Lane-specific card for the G79-DZD unique-TIF page. The canonical project decision remains run_card.json (G79-THVC).
hypothesis: H79-H2 (G79-DZD): geothermal-conducive permeability concentrates in the damage zone adjacent to mapped faults (~200 m optimal cross-fault distance) rather than on the mapped traces, so unmapped splays and damage-zone fractures inside that envelope are plausible conduits absent from the USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue.
mechanism: Deterministic single-channel transform, no ML and no multi-physics stack: Euclidean distance from catalogue fault cells; Gaussian damage-zone score centred at 200 m cross-fault distance with 150 m sigma; modulated by local catalogue-gradient fault activity; zero on catalogue; zero outside footprint; top-12,000 sparse dots normalised to [0,1].
named_non_fault_mimic: Pleistocene pluvial paleo-shoreline benches (Lake Lahontan / Lake Bonneville), fluvial terrace risers, welded ash-flow caldera cooling joints, and alluvial-fan piedmont slope breaks.
distinct_from: G79-THVC (84-channel multi-physics ML ensemble with kernel-cover), G79-CJX (potential-field junction persistence).
submission_note: G79-DZD: fault damage-zone distance decay from USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue, zero on mapped faults, 12k sparse dots
